title: Create: Repolished
description: A Create Addon that adds new foods, items and better rose quartz processing!
body:
## Overview
Create: Repolished is a Create mod addon for Minecraft 1.21.1 that adds new automated food production and an optimized Rose Quartz processing recipe. Designed to fit seamlessly into base Create mechanics, this addon helps you streamline your kinetic factories and automate your survival food supply.

## Key Features
* **Automated Rose Quartz Processing:** Tired of standard sand and redstone recipes? This adds an alternative processing method using Create Mixers, Crushing Wheels, and Bulk Blasting to make Rose Quartz production faster and more efficient for automation setups.
* **New Create Food Items:** Adds Cooked French Fries and Super French Fries. Fully compatible with Create mechanical belts, deployers, and bulk cooking (smoking/blasting) so you can build a fully automated factory kitchen.
* **Seamless Textures:** All blocks and items feature high-quality textures that match the vanilla Create mod aesthetic perfectly.

## Getting Started
1. Install the base **Create Mod** for 1.21.1.
2. Use **JEI (Just Enough Items)** or **EMI** to view the exact mechanical recipes for the new food and Rose Quartz lines.
